ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary contiguous white regions occupy the lateral lobes, separated by a broad central black region. Extensive pixel-level mottling and salt-and-pepper stippling define the interface between the white and black fields, particularly on the inner edges of the lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees; vertical depth is roughly 1/6th of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jaggedness along the entire trailing edge with prominent pixel-amplitude peaks located medially on both lobes; trailing edge is distinct from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the lower boundary of both lobes, terminating in pointed, irregular distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-intensity white clusters (barnacle colonies) are detected at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes; secondary circular white spots are visible on the lower central black region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple horizontal and diagonal white linear marks (rake marks) disrupt the uniform black pigmentation of the central fluke area; several dark linear streaks extend vertically across the white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged serration along the trailing edges; heavy white scarring/barnacle colonization at distal tips.
